terms.definition: Replacing secret-looking keys (token, secret, password, authorization, api key) and secret-looking values (sk-..., Bearer ...) with [REDACTED] before a log line reaches the sink.
The id of the incoming request a piece of work belongs to, assigned from the x-request-id header or a new UUID; every log line carries it.
terms.distinction: Not a job id: work a request puts on the queue logs under that request's id, never a fresh one.
